The surname '''al'Dai''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Bili al'Dai]] - a resident of the [[Two Rivers]] and son of Hu.
*[[Hu al'Dai]] - a farmer in the Two Rivers and father of Bili.
*[[Lem al'Dai]] - a resident of the Two Rivers who likes to fight with his fists.
*[[Rad al'Dai]] - a resident of the Two Rivers and part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army.
*[[Willim al'Dai]] - Bili's grandfather, Hu's father and former member of the [[Emond's Field]] [[Village Council]].
